wire.session_status.retired_label.role: Sidebar/picker row status label (a plain-text suffix) for a session whose turn was cut by a build update
wire.session_status.retired_label.note: EN-only context sidecar. {base} is the row's ALREADY-composed status word (currently `Interrupted`), inserted verbatim; the suffix after the em dash names the cause (the app retired the turn to update; the operator did not stop it). One logical line: keep the cause short.
